findings.title: Open redirect via unvalidated next parameter
findings.description: res.redirect(req.query.next) sends the user to any URL supplied by the requester, including external sites, enabling phishing after a legitimate login. Only allow relative paths that start with a single '/' (and not '//'), otherwise fall back to /dashboard.
findings.suggestion: Validate next is a same-site relative path (startsWith('/') && !startsWith('//')) before redirecting.
